mapper.insert: insert into erp_approval_record (business_type, business_id, action, from_status, to_status, opinion, operator_id, operator_name, operate_time, create_by, create_time, remark) values (#{businessType}, #{businessId}, #{action}, #{fromStatus}, #{toStatus}, #{opinion}, #{operatorId}, #{operatorName}, #{operateTime}, #{createBy}, sysdate(), #{remark})
mapper.delete: delete from erp_approval_record where id in #{id}
